source.name: BLG – 'BLG is official law firm and jersey sleeve partner of Vancouver Whitecaps FC'
source.quote: announced a multi-year partnership on Thursday, unveiling BLG as the club’s Official Law Firm and Jersey Sleeve Partner
source.note: Same release: the first team first wore the BLG sleeve patch on 1 June 2025 in the Concacaf Champions Cup Final against Cruz Azul. No deal value reported. SportsBusinessJournal (30 May 2025, Alex Silverman, https://www.sportsbusinessjournal.com/Articles/2025/05/30/whitecaps-add-first-jersey-sleeve-sponsor-ahead-of-champions-cup-final) reports the term: "The three-year sponsorship agreement, financial terms of which were not disclosed, will run through the end of the 2027 MLS season."

note: Multi-year right-sleeve partnership that began during the 2025 season.
